generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept game asset, transparent world sprite preview. Image 1 role: style and exact material/color identity reference only. Content ID / role: SKILL-006, boomerang projectile/world object. Intended use: one boomerang launched and returned by Unity, rotating in flight; must read at roughly 30–44 screen pixels. View/composition: square master, isolated object, 3/4 top-down gameplay view, centered pivot at the boomerang's visual center, broad crescent shape, main tips aimed upper-right and lower-right so the overall forward axis is rightward, fills about 68% of canvas, generous even transparent padding for rotation. Style: stylized 2D storybook cutout, hand-drawn, chunky, strong silhouette; thick slightly irregular deep-plum outer contour near #241B2B; flat matte warm red-brown wood, restrained brass caps, one dusty-teal cloth grip; simple cel shading and subtle wood texture that survives downscale. Design: compact sturdy returning boomerang, two rounded reinforced tips, no extra blades; visibly different from a metal ricochet disk. Output: genuinely transparent background, clean RGBA alpha, no halo, no baked shadow. Avoid: arrows, motion trails, glow, speed lines, particles, ground plane, scene, frame, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, character, hands, photorealism, 3D render, pixel art, tiny ornament, cropped edges.
constraints: distinct from the metal ricochet disk
